text: I can model a permission scheme in RBAC, including role hierarchy and separation of duty, and count when it explodes into too many roles.
I can rewrite a set of RBAC roles as one ABAC policy and name the PEP, PDP and PIP in a concrete deployment.
I can choose between RBAC, ABAC and ReBAC for a given product and explain each model's failure mode.
I can scope a cloud IAM policy by action, resource and condition, and explain how an over-privileged role turned the Capital One SSRF into a mass data theft.
I can design service-to-service auth with mTLS and short-lived workload identities, and explain how to avoid the confused deputy problem.
